scope: Explicit exact public-input acquisition and image-builder wiring, not inference, model admission or audio-device authorization
implementation: Acquire the exact Whisper source commit, original model license, model weight and three corresponding eSpeak source archives into a new exclusive runtime context. Every input has a fixed size and SHA256, verified again in the image Docker recipe

Optional cached input directories are explicit and nonredirected; files must be regular, stable, single-linked and exact. Acquisition preserves mismatching inert partial inputs rather than overwriting or executing them
HTTPS inputs refuse downgrade redirects and use bounded streaming/deadlines. Model weights are never executed, treated as a text-model GGUF, or inferred to confer model authority

The image assembler invokes the fixed source-bound runtime builder before verity sealing. Speech image verification binds corresponding source, actual compiler recipe, binary/runtime hashes and conservative no-qualification declarations
This acquisition checkpoint does not verify a final whole image. Later assembler and desktop integration changes require a separately identified source sweep and image
